summary: First full test run of Proietta (master/player image broadcasting). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass including room CRUD, join validation, image URL send, multipart upload + file download, master token auth (403/404), WebSocket real-time image broadcast, room close flow. Frontend: complete two-context e2e passed — create room, player join with valid code, waiting-state, URL image broadcast (player receives image+caption live), upload broadcast (serves via /api/files/), history sheet shows received images, master close room navigates both master and player back to landing.

issues: Master WebSocket logs 'closed before connection established' warning on StrictMode double-mount — harmless but noisy; consider cleaning up in effect with readyState check.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: upload stores bytes then checks size after read — move size check before put_object to avoid pushing oversized data (minor).

server.py: presence_count on disconnect is computed before disconnect() is called inside the except branch — current code does disconnect first, then recomputes count; OK. But presence_leave is broadcast after count in disconnect path; consider ordering leave before count for consistency.
server.py: GET /api/files/{path} exposes any file by storage_path (no room-scoped auth). Acceptable for public projector model but note it's publicly readable by anyone with the path.
MasterDashboard.jsx: master WS not used for receiving images (only presence); that's fine. Missing reconnect logic on WS drop for both master and player.
Frontend: /master/new creates a new room on every visit without existing token — OK given flow, but no guard against duplicate creation if user refreshes /master/new (new rooms created).
seed_data_creation: Created transient rooms during tests. Players prefixed TEST_. Rooms created during backend tests are left inactive after close_room test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_proietta.py covers all endpoints + WebSocket. Reuse for regression. Frontend testids confirmed working: create-room-btn, join-room-btn, room-code-input, player-name-input, join-submit-btn, image-url-input, caption-input, mode-url-btn, mode-upload-btn, file-input, send-image-btn, room-code-display, current-image, current-caption, player-history-trigger, waiting-state, close-room-btn.
